snippet.title: FNAF Security Breach | Cut Content Restored Showcase Trailer
snippet.description:
Cut Content Restored is a Vanilla SB mod that plans to expand the Pizzaplex Steel Wool left us with, bringing back content from the Pre-Release build, and content from the Pre-Release maps, while still keeping the current SB experience.

This mod also plans to properly bring back night lighting to its original scope, a feature that is very underused in the final game.

► Game Banana page: https://gamebanana.com/wips/90175
